1→//! HKDF-SHA256 deterministic IPNS keypair derivation.
     2→//!
     3→//! Derives deterministic Ed25519 IPNS keypairs from a secp256k1 private key
     4→//! using HKDF-SHA256 with domain-separated info strings. Matches the TypeScript
     5→//! implementations in `@cipherbox/crypto` (vault/derive-ipns.ts, file/derive-ipns.ts,
     6→//! registry/derive-ipns.ts).
     7→//!
     8→//! Derivation path:
     9→//!   secp256k1 privateKey (32 bytes)
    10→//!     -> HKDF-SHA256(salt="CipherBox-v1", info=<domain-specific>)
    11→//!     -> 32-byte Ed25519 seed
    12→//!     -> Ed25519 keypair
    13→//!     -> IPNS name (k51...)
    14→
    15→use ed25519_dalek::SigningKey;
    16→use hkdf::Hkdf;
    17→use sha2::Sha256;
    18→use thiserror::Error;
    19→use zeroize::{Zeroize, Zeroizing};
    20→
    21→use super::ipns;
    22→
    23→/// Common HKDF salt for all CipherBox derivations.
    24→const HKDF_SALT: &[u8] = b"CipherBox-v1";
    25→
    26→/// HKDF info for vault IPNS keypair derivation (root folder metadata).
    27→const VAULT_HKDF_INFO: &[u8] = b"cipherbox-vault-ipns-v1";
    28→
    29→/// HKDF info for vault key blob IPNS keypair derivation (rootFolderKey storage).
    30→const VAULT_KEY_HKDF_INFO: &[u8] = b"cipherbox-vault-key-ipns-v1";
    31→
    32→/// HKDF info for device registry IPNS keypair derivation.
    33→const REGISTRY_HKDF_INFO: &[u8] = b"cipherbox-device-registry-ipns-v1";
    34→
    35→/// HKDF info for recycle bin IPNS keypair derivation.
    36→const BIN_HKDF_INFO: &[u8] = b"cipherbox-recycle-bin-ipns-v1";
    37→
    38→/// HKDF info prefix for per-file IPNS keypair derivation.
    39→const FILE_HKDF_INFO_PREFIX: &str = "cipherbox-file-ipns-v1:";
    40→
    41→/// Minimum file ID length (matches TypeScript validation).
    42→const MIN_FILE_ID_LENGTH: usize = 10;
    43→
    44→#[derive(Debug, Error)]
    45→pub enum HkdfError {
    46→    #[error("Invalid key size")]
    47→    InvalidKeySize,
    48→    #[error("HKDF derivation failed")]
    49→    DerivationFailed,
    50→    #[error("IPNS name derivation failed")]
    51→    IpnsDerivationFailed,
    52→    #[error("Invalid file ID: must be at least {MIN_FILE_ID_LENGTH} characters")]
    53→    InvalidFileId,
    54→}
    55→
    56→/// Internal helper: derive an Ed25519 keypair and IPNS name from HKDF output.
    57→///
    58→/// All three public functions follow the same pattern and delegate here.
    59→fn derive_ipns_keypair(
    60→    user_private_key: &[u8; 32],
    61→    info: &[u8],
    62→) -> Result<(Zeroizing<Vec<u8>>, Vec<u8>, String), HkdfError> {
    63→    // 1. HKDF-SHA256: extract + expand
    64→    let hk = Hkdf::<Sha256>::new(Some(HKDF_SALT), user_private_key);
    65→    let mut okm = [0u8; 32];
    66→    hk.expand(info, &mut okm)
    67→        .map_err(|_| HkdfError::DerivationFailed)?;
    68→
    69→    // 2. Ed25519 keypair from 32-byte seed
    70→    let signing_key = SigningKey::from_bytes(&okm);
    71→    okm.zeroize();
    72→    let verifying_key = signing_key.verifying_key();
    73→
    74→    let private_key = Zeroizing::new(signing_key.to_bytes().to_vec());
    75→    let public_key = verifying_key.to_bytes().to_vec();
    76→
    77→    // 3. Derive IPNS name from public key
    78→    let pk_array: [u8; 32] = verifying_key.to_bytes();
    79→    let ipns_name = ipns::derive_ipns_name(&pk_array).map_err(|_| HkdfError::IpnsDerivationFailed)?;
    80→
    81→    Ok((private_key, public_key, ipns_name))
    82→}
    83→
    84→/// Derive the deterministic Ed25519 IPNS keypair for the user's vault.
    85→///
    86→/// Uses HKDF info "cipherbox-vault-ipns-v1" for domain separation.
    87→///
    88→/// Given the same secp256k1 privateKey, this always produces the same
    89→/// IPNS name, enabling vault discovery from any device with the user's key.
    90→///
    91→/// Returns (ed25519_private_key, ed25519_public_key, ipns_name).
    92→pub fn derive_vault_ipns_keypair(
    93→    user_private_key: &[u8; 32],
    94→) -> Result<(Zeroizing<Vec<u8>>, Vec<u8>, String), HkdfError> {
    95→    derive_ipns_keypair(user_private_key, VAULT_HKDF_INFO)
    96→}
    97→
    98→/// Derive a dedicated Ed25519 IPNS keypair for the vault key blob.
    99→///
   100→/// This IPNS name stores the v2 blob containing the ECIES-wrapped rootFolderKey.
   101→/// Separate from the root folder IPNS name to avoid folder publishes overwriting the key blob.
   102→///
   103→/// Uses HKDF info "cipherbox-vault-key-ipns-v1" for domain separation.
   104→pub fn derive_vault_key_ipns_keypair(
   105→    user_private_key: &[u8; 32],
   106→) -> Result<(Zeroizing<Vec<u8>>, Vec<u8>, String), HkdfError> {
   107→    derive_ipns_keypair(user_private_key, VAULT_KEY_HKDF_INFO)
   108→}
   109→
   110→/// Derive a deterministic Ed25519 IPNS keypair for a specific file.
   111→///
   112→/// Uses HKDF info "cipherbox-file-ipns-v1:{fileId}" for per-file domain separation.
   113→///
   114→/// Returns (ed25519_private_key, ed25519_public_key, ipns_name).
   115→pub fn derive_file_ipns_keypair(
   116→    user_private_key: &[u8; 32],
   117→    file_id: &str,
   118→) -> Result<(Zeroizing<Vec<u8>>, Vec<u8>, String), HkdfError> {
   119→    if file_id.len() < MIN_FILE_ID_LENGTH {
   120→        return Err(HkdfError::InvalidFileId);
   121→    }
   122→
   123→    let info = format!("{}{}", FILE_HKDF_INFO_PREFIX, file_id);
   124→    derive_ipns_keypair(user_private_key, info.as_bytes())
   125→}
   126→
   127→/// Derive the deterministic Ed25519 IPNS keypair for the device registry.
   128→///
   129→/// Uses HKDF info "cipherbox-device-registry-ipns-v1" for domain separation.
   130→///
   131→/// Returns (ed25519_private_key, ed25519_public_key, ipns_name).
   132→pub fn derive_registry_ipns_keypair(
   133→    user_private_key: &[u8; 32],
   134→) -> Result<(Zeroizing<Vec<u8>>, Vec<u8>, String), HkdfError> {
   135→    derive_ipns_keypair(user_private_key, REGISTRY_HKDF_INFO)
   136→}
   137→
   138→/// Derive the deterministic Ed25519 IPNS keypair for the recycle bin.
   139→///
   140→/// Uses HKDF info "cipherbox-recycle-bin-ipns-v1" for domain separation.
   141→///
   142→/// Returns (ed25519_private_key, ed25519_public_key, ipns_name).
   143→pub fn derive_bin_ipns_keypair(
   144→    user_private_key: &[u8; 32],
   145→) -> Result<(Zeroizing<Vec<u8>>, Vec<u8>, String), HkdfError> {
   146→    derive_ipns_keypair(user_private_key, BIN_HKDF_INFO)
   147→}
